name: sample_capability
description: Exchange Rate Capability using the Frankfurter API to fetch current and historical currency exchange rates.

message.content:
### 💱 Exchange Rate
- **From:** <? from_currency ?>
- **To:** <? to_currency ?>
- **Rate:** 1 <? from_currency ?> = <? exchange_rate ?> <? to_currency ?>
- **Date:** <? response_date ?>

content.prompt: How useful was this exchange rate information?

message.content: Thank you for your feedback! Your rating of **<? saved_rating ?>/5** has been recorded.

scenarios.name: get_exchange_rate
scenarios.description: Get current or historical exchange rates between two currencies using the Frankfurter API.

slots.name: currency_from
slots.description: The source currency code to convert from (e.g., USD, GBP, INR)

slots.name: currency_to
slots.description: The target currency code to convert to (e.g., EUR, JPY, CHF)

slots.name: currency_date
slots.description: The date for the exchange rate (YYYY-MM-DD) or "latest" for current rates

slots.name: user_rating
slots.description: User rating score for the exchange rate service (1 to 5)

response_context.description: The exchange rate value between the two currencies
The date of the exchange rate
